title: Google signs $3B+ hydro PPAs with Brookfield under 3 GW framework

sources.quote: The first contracts executed under the HFA are for Brookfield’s Holtwood and Safe Harbor hydroelectric facilities in Pennsylvania, representing more than $3 billion of power and 670 MW of capacity.

Under the HFA, Google has the ability to procure carbon-free electricity from up to 3,000 MWs of hydroelectric assets that will be relicensed, overhauled, or upgraded to extend the asset’s useful life and continue adding power to the grid.

explain: Google signed 20-year power purchase agreements worth more than $3 billion for 670 MW from two Brookfield hydro dams in Pennsylvania, the first deals under a framework for up to 3,000 MW of hydro. The amount is a floor ('more than $3 billion'). Plants: Holtwood Hydroelectric Station and Safe Harbor Dam, Pennsylvania.
